LanguageData.CC_Caller_Hand_Begin: {PAWN_nameDef} goes to take the {THING} out to {OTHER_nameDef}.
LanguageData.CC_Caller_Hand_None: {PAWN} had to go before the piece was brought out, and took nothing and paid nothing.

LanguageData.CC_Caller_Cut_Part: {PAWN} cut the hair of {1} of the {2} before going on.
LanguageData.CC_Caller_Cut_None: {PAWN} had to go before anyone sat down for a cut.

LanguageData.CC_Caller_Vet_Part: {PAWN} saw to {1} of the {2} before going on.
LanguageData.CC_Caller_Vet_None: {PAWN} had to go before seeing to any of the colony's animals.

LanguageData.CC_Caller_Graves_None: {PAWN}'s order had to go before laying any of the dead to rest.

LanguageData.CC_Caller_Vet_Nothing: None of the colony's animals is hurt or sick now.
